$comment: Phase-2 wave-2 OpenConnector ingestion config for Sweden (Avropa.se, the Swedish national framework-agreement procurement centre). concurrentie-analyse/scripts/sync/sync_sweden_avropa.py runs an RSS feed + a CSV export + an unused key-gated REST API; this file ports the RSS feed (the CSV is a bulk-file blocker like Ireland/Canada, and the REST API needs a key - both out of this keyless connector's scope). Engine path: XML (RSS 2.0), reaching OpenConnector's simplexml_load_string()+xmlToArray() fallback (the one estonia_rhr.json documented - json_decode fails on an XML body, triggering the XML path). This is the FIRST RSS/channel/item feed in this directory (Estonia was a bare-<OPEN-DATA>-wrapping-<ContractNotice> shape), so the resultsPosition/field paths below were pinned by LIVE-VERIFICATION against the real feed 2026-07-07, not assumed. xmlToArray converts the `<rss>` root to `{channel:{item:[...]}}`; `resultsPosition: 'channel.item'` reaches the repeated `<item>` list, and every leaf is wrapped `{'#text': '<value>'}` (namespace prefixes stripped, so `<dc:creator>` -> `creator`, `<content:encoded>` -> `encoded`) - hence every field is `x.#text` (bare) or `x['#text']` (Twig). Public, unauthenticated (keyless - the script's only key-gated variant is the REST API it explicitly does NOT use). Faithful-mapping caveats vs the Python script (all inherent to the RSS feed, documented in the script itself): no CPV codes in RSS (`cpvCodes` -> static []), no submission deadline in RSS (`closingDate` unmapped), procedure/type hardcoded 'framework_agreement' (Avropa is a framework-agreement centre), country/EU-flag hardcoded (SE / national). `organisation` falls back to the centre's own name when `<dc:creator>` is absent, matching the script. The script's own IT-keyword filter is a DB-side classification layer, not an API constraint (same as TenderNed/TED) - this connector ingests the full feed. `publicationDate` converts the RSS RFC-822 `<pubDate>` to Y-m-d via Twig's date filter (strtotime-parseable). LIVE-VERIFIED 2026-07-07 on the isolated spectr-spike instance (NC 34, OR 0.2.17-unstable.13, OC 0.2.16+#105, spectr register id=8) - see connectors/README.md's W2 table and IMPORT.md for the run evidence (rows, field spot-check incl. the #text unwrap, dedup re-run).

objects.name: Avropa.se (Swedish framework-agreement procurement)
objects.description: Swedish national framework-agreement procurement centre (Statens inkopscentral / Avropa.se), public RSS feed. Keyless. Reaches OpenConnector's XML (simplexml) fallback. Feeds the spectr `tender` register/schema via the sweden-avropa-to-spectr-tender synchronization.

objects.name: Avropa RSS to Spectr Tender
objects.description: Maps a single converted RSS <item> (post-xmlToArray, every leaf a {'#text':...} wrapper) onto the spectr `tender` schema. Mirrors sync_sweden_avropa.py's upsert_rss_entry() - see file $comment for the RSS-inherent gaps (no CPV, no closing date) and the #text unwrap convention.

objects.name: Avropa RSS to Spectr Tender
objects.description: Wave-2 ingestion sync: Avropa's procurement RSS feed -> spectr register, tender schema. `resultsPosition: 'channel.item'` (RSS 2.0 <rss><channel><item> - the item list becomes an array after xmlToArray). `usesPagination: false` - a single RSS feed, no next-page concept.

objects.name: Avropa Sweden Weekly Sync
objects.description: Runs the sweden-avropa-to-spectr-tender synchronization weekly, matching Specter's own tendril cadence.
